Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: Brightware / Redwood Inference — next steps

Hi Evelyn / Ryan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

1) Business goals we heard
   - Brightware needs predictable latency for search & summarization features across EU and US users.
   - Target cost per 1M tokens must be under $X to fit the current roadmap.

2) Current constraints / notes
   - Privacy: data residency for EU; potential requirement for Private deployment or Dedicated.
   - Procurement: legal prefers standard MSA but will ask a couple of clauses around data retention.

3) Proposed pilot (what we can move on quickly)
   - 3-week pilot on Dedicated with a small GPU pool to validate latency and cost.
   - Redwood will provide a short performance baseline + prefix-caching config.

4) Action items / owners
   - Marissa (me): Send discovery recap + pilot SOW template — attached.
   - Evelyn / Ryan: Share any compliance docs that must be included in the SOW (SOC 2 evidence, data residency constraints).
   - Rafael (Eng): Ready to scope infra if you want a quick walkthrough next week.

Next step proposal: 30-min follow-up demo & cost walkthrough next week (I have availability Tue/Wed 9–11am PT). Please let me know which time works or if I should loop in your procurement/IT contact.

Attachment: Brightware_Discovery_Recap.pdf (brief slides + mutual action plan)

Appreciate the time — excited to see if Redwood is a fit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
